epochs.description: Original wrapper allowed item actions behind reading cards; affected sequences documented and retained.

Modal guard introduced; subsequently JSON-only errors and per-session single-writer lock. Exact intermediate wrapper bytes were not separately frozen; actual game observations and rejected wrapper actions retained.
Complete documented action schemas and place alias; ordinary finite-coordinate move, no outcome hint. All later role cohorts received stable neutral contract.

limits: Not a byte-identical interface across all sessions. Engine/story hashes do not certify wrapper version.
Global partners and all-history items differ from current-panel browser presentation.
Replacement participants and surviving cohorts can have different prior interface experience.
Technical waits/schema errors are excluded from game pacing conclusions.
